description: Sector info, scans, and port details respect proximity and do not reveal port class remotely

tests.name: Setup: Information visibility user
Rig: Put the player in sector one

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id = 1 WHERE player_id = @{information_visibility_user_player_id};

tests.name: Rig: Put the player's ship in sector one

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id = 1 WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id = @{information_visibility_user_player_id});

tests.name: Rig: Prepare a remote port

data.sql: UPDATE ports SET sector_id = 2 WHERE port_id = 2;

tests.name: Refresh information user location from the server
Current sector information is available
Find a directly adjacent sector for the visibility boundary test

data.sql: SELECT to_sector FROM sector_warps WHERE from_sector = (SELECT sector_id FROM players WHERE player_id = @{information_visibility_user_player_id}) ORDER BY to_sector LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Directly adjacent sector information is available
Remote sector information is refused
Rig: Clear prior port knowledge before detailed scan

data.sql: DELETE FROM player_known_ports WHERE player_id = @{information_visibility_user_player_id}

tests.name: Detailed scan omits port class
A scan does not record remote port knowledge

data.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_known_ports WHERE player_id = @{information_visibility_user_player_id};

tests.name: Rig: Clear stale landed state before planet visibility tests

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET onplanet = FALSE WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id = @{information_visibility_user_player_id})

tests.name: Remote port information is refused
Remote trade.port_info alias is refused
Remote port refusal does not create port knowledge

data.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_known_ports WHERE player_id = @{information_visibility_user_player_id} AND port_id = 2;

tests.name: Rig: Mark only sectors one and two as visited

data.sql: INSERT INTO player_visited_sectors (player_id, sector_id) VALUES (@{information_visibility_user_player_id}, 1), (@{information_visibility_user_player_id}, 2) ON CONFLICT (player_id, sector_id) DO NOTHING;

tests.name: Pathfind can use a visited adjacent sector
Pathfind does not reveal an unvisited sector
Unowned planet details are hidden before landing
Remote planet details are hidden
Rig: Land ship on the unowned planet

data.sql: UPDATE players SET lastplanet = 700 WHERE player_id = @{information_visibility_user_player_id}

tests.name: Rig: Mark the ship landed

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET onplanet = TRUE WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id = @{information_visibility_user_player_id})

tests.name: Rig: Seed visible planet goods for info response

data.sql: INSERT INTO planet_goods (planet_id, commodity, quantity, max_capacity, production_rate) VALUES (700, 'ORE', 0, 1000, 0) ON CONFLICT (planet_id, commodity) DO NOTHING

tests.name: Planet details become available after landing
Port information is available while in its sector
Rig: Clear prior visits for isolated sector fixture

data.sql: DELETE FROM player_visited_sectors WHERE sector_id IN (980001, 980002, 980003)

tests.name: Rig: Clear prior warps for isolated sector fixture

data.sql: DELETE FROM sector_warps WHERE from_sector IN (980001, 980002, 980003) OR to_sector IN (980001, 980002, 980003)

tests.name: Rig: Remove prior isolated sectors

data.sql: DELETE FROM sectors WHERE sector_id IN (980001, 980002, 980003)

tests.name: Rig: Seed isolated directional adjacency sectors

data.sql: INSERT INTO sectors (sector_id, name) VALUES (980001, 'Fog Direction A'), (980002, 'Fog Direction B'), (980003, 'Fog Hidden Route Target')

tests.name: Rig: Put player in directional adjacency origin sector

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id = 980001 WHERE player_id = @{information_visibility_user_player_id}

tests.name: Rig: Put ship in directional adjacency origin sector

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id = 980001 WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id = @{information_visibility_user_player_id})

tests.name: Refresh directional adjacency origin from server state
Rig: Configure outgoing-only warp A to B

data.sql: DELETE FROM sector_warps WHERE from_sector IN (980001, 980002) AND to_sector IN (980001, 980002)

tests.name: Rig: Add outgoing warp A to B

data.sql: INSERT INTO sector_warps (from_sector, to_sector) VALUES (980001, 980002)

tests.name: Outgoing-only warp makes target sector adjacent
Rig: Reverse the warp to incoming-only B to A

data.sql: DELETE FROM sector_warps WHERE from_sector = 980001 AND to_sector = 980002

tests.name: Rig: Add incoming-only warp B to A

data.sql: INSERT INTO sector_warps (from_sector, to_sector) VALUES (980002, 980001)

tests.name: Incoming-only warp does not make B adjacent from A
Incoming-only warp is also refused by move.describe_sector alias
Refused incoming-only request does not persist sector knowledge

data.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_visited_sectors WHERE player_id = @{information_visibility_user_player_id} AND sector_id = 980002

tests.name: Rig: Make the warp bidirectional

data.sql: INSERT INTO sector_warps (from_sector, to_sector) VALUES (980001, 980002)

tests.name: Bidirectional warp makes target sector adjacent
Allowed adjacency requests do not persist new sector knowledge

data.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_visited_sectors WHERE player_id = @{information_visibility_user_player_id} AND sector_id = 980002

tests.name: Previously discovered sector knowledge remains intact

data.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_visited_sectors WHERE player_id = @{information_visibility_user_player_id} AND sector_id = 2

tests.name: Rig: Mark pathfind target discovered

data.sql: INSERT INTO player_visited_sectors (player_id, sector_id) VALUES (@{information_visibility_user_player_id}, 980003) ON CONFLICT (player_id, sector_id) DO NOTHING

tests.name: Rig: Add route through undiscovered intermediate sector

data.sql: INSERT INTO sector_warps (from_sector, to_sector) VALUES (980001, 980002), (980002, 980003) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

tests.name: Pathfind does not use or disclose an undiscovered intermediate sector
Blocked pathfind does not discover its intermediate sector

data.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_visited_sectors WHERE player_id = @{information_visibility_user_player_id} AND sector_id = 980002

tests.name: Rig: Restore player sector

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id = 1 WHERE player_id = @{information_visibility_user_player_id}

tests.name: Rig: Restore ship sector

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id = 1 WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id = @{information_visibility_user_player_id})

tests.name: Refresh restored player sector
Rig: Remove isolated sector knowledge

data.sql: DELETE FROM player_visited_sectors WHERE player_id = @{information_visibility_user_player_id} AND sector_id IN (980001, 980002, 980003)

tests.name: Rig: Remove isolated sector warps

data.sql: DELETE FROM sector_warps WHERE from_sector IN (980001, 980002, 980003) OR to_sector IN (980001, 980002, 980003)

tests.name: Rig: Remove isolated sectors

data.sql: DELETE FROM sectors WHERE sector_id IN (980001, 980002, 980003)
